author: OpenCut / Codex
label: שוחזר על ידי OpenCut
basis: Pinned upstream composition and sampled local rendered frames; these are reconstructed instructions, not recovered original prompts.

prompts.split-flap-board: Create a close-up horizontal mechanical split-flap board on a softly lit charcoal background. Flip individual black letter cells through intermediate glyphs at slightly staggered times until they read NOW BOARDING in cream uppercase. Show each cell's center hinge and subtle depth, with a readable final hold over a 3.5-second composition.
prompts.swirl-vortex: Build a four-second shader transition from dark teal to bright mint green using opposing vortex distortion around the center. Keep the demo's broad color fields and the right-side SWIRL VORTEX technical title and prompt note. For a remix, preserve the shader's spatial warp when substituting detailed outgoing and incoming scene textures.
prompts.thermal-distortion: Transition a muted indigo scene to warm coral using a shader that introduces heat-shimmer displacement rising from below. Keep the source demo's broad color fields and small THERMAL DISTORTION title with prompt annotation on the right. Settle into the coral scene after the distortion passes.
prompts.transitions-3d: Create an eleven-second transition demo with a dark 3D TRANSITIONS title card, a navy scene labelled ONE and a coral scene labelled TWO. Rotate the outgoing and incoming cards around the vertical axis in a synchronized 3D flip, label the effect 3D Card Flip in a slim bottom bar, and finish with a short closing title.
prompts.transitions-blur: Build a twenty-second blur-transition showcase between navy ONE and coral TWO scenes. Demonstrate a soft defocus-and-scale swap, a directional blur with horizontal skew and travel, and a stronger full-frame defocus that resolves into the incoming scene. Separate the examples with readable holds and small effect labels, framed by dark opening and closing cards.
prompts.transitions-cover: Create a twenty-one-second cover-transition showcase using navy ONE and coral TWO scenes. Demonstrate staggered colored blocks, layered horizontal color strips and vertical blinds that fully cover the frame before revealing the incoming scene. Use saturated violet, blue, cyan and pink cover elements, compact bottom labels, and a simple Cover Transitions opening and closing card.
prompts.transitions-destruction: Make a fourteen-second page-burn transition demo. Begin with a dark Destruction Transitions title card, then burn outward through the navy outgoing scene with an irregular glowing orange edge to expose the coral TWO scene. Include a small Page Burn label during the effect and finish on a dark closing card identifying the single demonstrated transition.
prompts.settings-toggle-flow: Present a compact white settings card on a pale gray stage with three rows: Auto captions, Brand kit and Sound effects. Reveal the rows in sequence and pop their small switch controls into place. Show the first two options enabled and the last disabled, with a short gray description beneath each setting name.
prompts.shared-axis-y: Create a white rounded demo card on a pale stage with a small MODE caption, Plan/Debug/Ask tabs and a fine divider. Beneath them, bring the three large dark words Plan, Debug and Ask upward along a shared vertical axis with a short stagger. Keep all three words side by side in the final layout; this reference demonstrates their entrance, not interactive tab switching.
prompts.sheet-spring-up: Show a phone with a blurred green wallpaper on a dark green demo stage. Spring a white Share sheet upward from below the frame, overshoot slightly and settle it in the middle of the phone. Include a green media preview with a play icon and small Decline and Accept actions, preserving the reference's measured spring motion and explanatory caption to the right.
prompts.shimmer-sweep: Use a near-black canvas with the large white headline AI-Powered, the muted subtitle Video generation, reimagined and a small violet Try it free pill. Fade the elements in with staggered timing, then sweep a soft highlight across the text and button. Hold the minimal centered layout between shimmer passes.
prompts.scroll-feed: Show a dark narrow social feed window containing eight repeated skeleton post cards with avatar dots, short text lines and gray image placeholders. Scroll the cards upward at a frantic pace, clipping them cleanly at the top and bottom of the rounded viewport. Keep the surrounding stage near black and retain subtle motion blur during travel.
prompts.sdf-iris: Create a circular iris shader transition from deep teal to golden yellow. Open an aspect-correct disc from the center with a bright warm multi-ring rim, expanding until yellow fills the incoming scene. Retain the reference's compact SDF IRIS technical label and prompt annotation in the right-side panel.
prompts.segmentation-flood: Arrange four pale geometric objects on a light lavender stage. Sweep translucent blue segmentation bands over each region, adding blue corner brackets and compact labels Chassis, Payload, Horizon and Beacon. Stagger the detection overlays and hold all four labelled regions once the flood is complete.
prompts.rubber-band-bumper: Place a dark outgoing scene labelled Hold the tension inside a rounded frame. Pull it horizontally against visible violet elastic bands, with resistance increasing on repeated tugs. Release the tension in a quick snap that reveals the incoming Clean release scene, then let the new scene settle smoothly.
prompts.scan-band: Center the bold white wordmark SCAN MODE in a near-black rounded panel. Sweep an angled scan band across the letters, briefly disturbing their appearance before restoring crisp solid type. Keep the effect localized to the wordmark and hold the clean result on the dark stage.
prompts.scramble-reveal: Use a dark panel and a centered violet monospace phrase. Begin with deterministic scrambled characters and resolve them from left to right into SEEK SAFE, keeping already-resolved letters fixed. Finish on the clean complete phrase with a quiet readable hold.
prompts.scroll-camera-story: Create a pale blue-gray vertical product story with four white content sections, subtle abstract circles and small blue accents. Move the camera down the long surface, pausing on successive numbered sections with skeleton text and finishing on a centered call-to-action button. Preserve smooth continuous spatial travel between the sections.
prompts.radial-surround: Place a dark central card labelled One workspace on a near-black stage. Introduce six small application chips labelled Slack, Email, CRM, Tickets, Docs and Sheets around it with staggered cues. Arrange them in a radial ring, then draw them inward around the central workspace while keeping its label readable.
prompts.ridged-burn: Create a four-second shader transition from a nearly black field into solid red. Let irregular bright orange-white ridges eat across the outgoing surface like glowing cracks, exposing red through expanding holes. Retain the reference's right-side RIDGED BURN technical title and compact prompt caption while the transition plays in the large left area.
prompts.ripple-waves: Build a shader transition between deep blue-green and warm yellow scenes. Send sine-wave ripples through the transition boundary so the colors bend and move in opposite phases, settling into the yellow incoming scene. Preserve the small RIPPLE WAVES title and monospaced prompt annotation on the right.
prompts.particle-text-dissolve: On a near-black stage, resolve a dense cloud of tiny violet particles into the large word Particles. Sweep the particle front across the letters from left to right, leaving crisp solid type behind it. Clear the remaining particles and hold the complete violet word centered.
prompts.per-word-crossfade: Use a pale background with a large muted phrase Write once publish anywhere above a smaller dark replacement line. Crossfade the individual words into Create once reuse everywhere with staggered timing, then remove the old phrase and hold the replacement. Include a quiet PER-WORD CROSSFADE demo caption below.
prompts.per-word-rise: Reveal the violet uppercase line EVERY FRAME MATTERS inside a dark rounded panel. Split the demo into characters and raise them into place with staggered opacity and blur, progressing across the line. Finish with all characters sharp, evenly spaced and stationary.
prompts.perspective-marquee: Run a continuous horizontal row of black rounded word pills across a pale gray stage. Use bold white labels such as COMPONENTS, PRIMITIVES, TRANSITIONS and AGENTS, allowing pills to enter and leave at the frame edges. Keep consistent gaps and a steady marquee pace over five seconds.
prompts.pull-to-refresh: Create a narrow dark mobile activity feed with a search field and four compact activity rows. Pull the content downward to reveal a three-dot mint refresh indicator, animate the dots during the refresh, then let the content return toward its resting position. Preserve the rounded phone-like panel and readable hierarchy.
prompts.rack-focus: Create a dark optical demonstration of rack focus using layers of small lights and warm, blue and cream bokeh shapes. Shift the focus plane over six seconds so large soft discs resolve into smaller bright points while another depth layer becomes blurred. Retain the thin focus-curve graphic and compact calibration marks near the bottom.
prompts.native-notification-pop: Stage a dark desktop-like surface with blurred green and violet light and a quiet skeleton content card. Slide a compact macOS-style notification into the upper right after 0.45 seconds. Show the app label Conveyor, the title Export finished and the body reel-final.mov saved to Renders, with a small blue app icon.
prompts.news-ticker: Create a broadcast lower-third overlay on transparency with a red LIVE and GLOBAL DESK badge, dark headline band and a smaller BREAKING ticker. Reveal the shell upward, stagger the headline and time, then scroll short news items continuously below. Highlight prototype in red within the demonstration headline about AI video tools, and sweep a brief highlight across the bar.
prompts.notes-typing: Show a realistic white mobile Notes screen in a dark green demo stage. Use the heading Things nobody told me about video. Type short candid lines underneath one character at a time, retaining pauses and the caret rhythm. Keep the yellow Notes control, bottom toolbar and a small explanatory demo caption to the right of the phone.
prompts.notification-stack: Inside a near-black panel, stack four compact dark notifications with blue status dots. Introduce Upload received, Transcode started, Scenes detected and Draft ready at staggered cues, moving earlier cards downward as each new card arrives. Give every title a small gray explanatory line and retain all four in the final expanded stack.
prompts.number-pop-in: Center a small bold black statistic reading 5.7 with a muted k suffix on a pale gray canvas. Pop the individual number characters into place with short staggered scale and rise motion, then hold the complete metric. Use generous empty space and no additional card or caption.
prompts.number-wheel: Fill a dark green stage with a large cream odometer-style number beneath the mint uppercase label GITHUB STARS. Roll the individual digit columns upward with staggered timing until they settle at the demonstration value 30222. Keep the final number bold and steady; treat it as sample content, not a live popularity count.
prompts.offset-path-traveler: Draw a thin dotted violet S-shaped path inside a near-black rounded panel. Move a small dark pill labelled Deploying along the curve, rotating it with the path tangent. Add a restrained violet status dot and glow; keep the track visible during the four-second traversal.
prompts.onboarding-stepper-flow: Create a pale onboarding screen with three circular step indicators above a white rounded card. Mark the second step active and show STEP 2 OF 3, Choose your visual style, a muted explanatory paragraph and a dark Continue button. Pop the indicators in sequentially, raise the card and give the active step a brief pulse.
prompts.ordered-dither-pass: Begin with a blue ordered-dither field on a pale canvas. Resolve the pixel pattern into a centered rounded gradient card shifting from blue through violet to coral, with the white title RESOLVE and small monospaced SIGNAL FROM NOISE subtitle. Use an eight-cell ordered pattern and three tone levels, then hold the clean card.
prompts.oscilloscope-trace: Render a green phosphor oscilloscope on a near-black technical stage. Sweep a bright point along a sine wave inside a fine grid, leaving a fading trail behind it. Place small monospaced readouts for source, frequency, timebase, vertical gain and phosphor persistence to the right. Keep the trace deterministic when seeking.
prompts.outline-draw: Create a dark navy rounded card with the small white word PROOF centered inside it. Draw a bright cyan rounded rectangular outline around the card, closing the remaining gap near its lower-left corner. Hold the completed stroke with even thickness and clean rounded corners.
prompts.oversized-cursor: Show a white document editor window against a dark stage, with a posts sidebar and the article Offline mode, one year in. Move an oversized white pointer to the Comments button at upper right, click it, highlight the target and reveal a small comment card beside the article. Keep the browser-like frame and article layout stable.
prompts.overwhelm-surround: Center a small Focus tile in a dark navy workspace. Animate about 22 tiny notification pills and badges inward from around it until they crowd its edges, using blue and orange indicators and varied slight rotations. Keep Focus readable at the center while the surrounding demands build into a dense cluster.
prompts.page-slide: On a pale stage, show a large rounded dark-blue page card labelled Dashboard. Slide the incoming teal-to-green Analytics page across the same frame, replacing the first page without changing its rounded silhouette. Use a smooth directional transition and hold the completed Analytics view.
prompts.pan-stations: Pan horizontally through a dark product-feature rail of rounded cards. Each card has a numbered station, green initial tile, small interface graphic and a large white action heading. Progress from Discover through the intermediate workflow stations to Publish and Measure, keeping neighboring cards partially visible during the camera movement.
prompts.panel-reveal: Reveal a compact white rounded panel on a pale gray stage with a soft shadow. Show the bold heading Motion tokens followed by the muted lines Duration 420ms and Easing power3.out. Bring the panel into view with restrained motion and hold its simple readable layout.
prompts.particle-image-reveal: Inside a dark rounded panel, gather small violet particles into a central cloud, then push them outward to reveal a square violet tile carrying a large H. Let the particles clear the edges and disappear while the tile remains steady. Preserve the sparse dark framing and soft violet accents.
prompts.mk-clone-wall-transition: Start with a full-frame pink-to-turquoise gradient card. Shrink it toward the center to reveal a black wall tiled with oversized white HyperFrames text. Drift the repeated words horizontally, sweep a white inversion strip across the wall, then fade the card and wall for the outgoing transition. Keep the complete move within 2.4 seconds.
prompts.mk-emphasis-type: Use an off-white stage with an oversized, very pale gray word EMPHASIS drifting horizontally. Fade it up and down as a quiet background typography layer rather than a foreground headline. Keep the low contrast and cropped wide lettering of the four-second demo.
prompts.mk-line-graph: Draw a compact two-series line chart on transparency. Reveal the axis and sequentially draw blue and mint lines through six labelled data points, showing numeric values beside the dots. Keep the blue series finishing at 58 and the mint series at 36. Hold the complete graph long enough to compare the trends.
prompts.mk-placeholder-grid: Assemble a three-panel layout on transparency: one tall pink rounded tile at left and two stacked mint and violet tiles at right. Centre the white numbers 1, 2 and 3 in their respective panels. Stagger their fade, rise and scale entrances with consistent gaps and a restrained shadow.
prompts.mk-progress-stat: Create a minimal statistic overlay on transparency with a large dark counter, the label Goals reached and a thin blue progress track underneath. Raise and fade the group in, count up smoothly to 22, and grow the progress line in sync. Hold the final value without adding a background card.
prompts.mk-specs-list: Build a compact specification list on transparency with five rows headed Design, Typography, Motion, Color and Shapes. Pair bold dark labels with smaller muted explanatory values and thin blue horizontal rules. Reveal the rows in sequence, preserving the left alignment and clear vertical spacing.
prompts.modal-morph: On a pale gray stage, begin with a small white notification-like card with a circular icon and skeleton text. Expand it smoothly into a broad white modal containing three aligned content columns, a compact header and small OPEN and DETAILS pills at bottom left. Keep the identity and position continuous through the morph.
prompts.morph-swap: Stage a small dark horizontal content card inside a larger near-black panel. Reshape it into a narrower portrait card while changing its surface and skeleton text accents to violet. Animate width, height and internal alignment together, then hold the final upright card.
prompts.motion-blur: Create a dark technical comparison with five horizontal lanes labelled DRIFT, GLIDE, RUSH, BLAST and WARP. Send a rounded gray marker and its white label across each lane with respective durations 3, 1.5, 0.7, 0.35 and 0.2 seconds. Use the reference's speed-driven blur treatment during travel and crisp settled markers at the right edge.
prompts.multiplayer-cursors: Place six colored pointer cursors with small name pills inside a dark navy rounded workspace. Label them Iris, Noah, Sam, Jo, Lee and Zed. Begin with the cursors distributed around the panel, guide them toward a shared central target, and hold a compact collaborative cluster with subtle colored glows.
prompts.beat-pulse-background: Create a dark navy ambient background with soft violet radial glows. Pulse their brightness and scale at 0.25, 0.75, 1.5, 2.25 and 3.25 seconds over a four-second composition. Keep the gradients blurred and text-free, with a stronger club-like beat accent that settles between pulses.
prompts.lt-accent-underline: Create a transparent lower third at the bottom left. Reveal DR. MAYA CHEN in bold white uppercase, draw a mint underline from left to right, then raise the small monospaced role Host - Neuroscientist beneath it. Hold the completed lockup and reverse the elements out near the end of a 4.8-second clip.
prompts.lt-bold-block: Build a compact transparent lower third with a black rectangular name panel and a yellow role strip. Wipe the panel in, raise MAYA CHEN with a slight overshoot, then spring the small HOST - NEUROSCIENTIST tag into place. Hold and wipe the entire panel off to the right near 4.3 seconds.
prompts.lt-clean-bar: Place a small white rounded name card at the lower left on transparency. Reveal it horizontally, grow a coral accent on its left edge, and raise the bold black name Dr. Maya Chen followed by the smaller gray role Host - Neuroscientist. Hold the readable card, then lower and fade it out near the end of 4.8 seconds.
prompts.lt-color-block: Create a transparent lower third with a bright blue rectangular panel at bottom left. Slide the panel in from the left with slight overshoot, then reveal DR. MAYA CHEN in large white uppercase and a small monospaced role beneath. Hold it in place before sliding left and fading out near 4.3 seconds.
prompts.lt-dark-card: Animate a compact near-black rounded name card on transparency. Raise and fade the card into the lower-left corner, reveal the bold white name Dr. Maya Chen, draw a yellow underline, and fade in a smaller gray Host - Neuroscientist label. Finish with a downward fade after the readable hold.
prompts.lt-kicker-name: Create a transparent lower third with a mint EPISODE 47 kicker above the white uppercase name MAYA CHEN. Pop the kicker into position, bring the name upward with a small overshoot, and draw a mint baseline beneath it. Hold the bottom-left layout, then retract the line and lift the text out.
prompts.lt-mask-reveal: Reveal the bold white lower-left name Dr. Maya Chen through a horizontal sweep mask over transparency. Let a thin bright sweep lead the reveal, then fade it away and raise the small muted role Host - Neuroscientist below. Hold the two lines and close the mask toward the right at the end.
prompts.lt-neon-border: Build a transparent lower third using a dark rounded card, bold white Dr. Maya Chen and a small uppercase role. Animate a warm gold light around the border while the card gently scales and fades into place. Keep the name and role readable during the hold, then lift their text and fade the card out.
prompts.lt-side-rule: On transparency, grow a slender mint vertical rule at the lower left. Slide the large white uppercase name DR. MAYA CHEN and a small monospaced role into alignment to its right. Keep the design open with no backing card, then fade the text and retract the rule at the end of 4.8 seconds.
prompts.lt-soft-pill: Create a small white pill-shaped lower third on transparency with a soft shadow, coral dot, bold black Dr. Maya Chen and small gray role below. Scale and raise the pill into place with a gentle bounce, pop the dot, and slide in the text. Hold, then shrink and lower the pill while fading it away.
prompts.lt-stack-bars: Place a black name bar over a slightly offset yellow role bar at bottom left on transparency. Reveal MAYA CHEN with a horizontal wipe, then reveal HOST - NEUROSCIENTIST underneath. Hold the separated stacked strips and retract them in opposing horizontal directions near the end.
prompts.menu-morph: On a pale gray stage, show a black circular menu button with three white horizontal strokes. Morph the strokes into an angular open-menu symbol and spring three white pill buttons labelled Text, Image and Audio into a row beneath it. Keep the compact interface centered with soft shadows and staggered button motion.
prompts.mesh-gradient-bg: Create a large dark rounded panel on a pale stage, with animated blue, pink and green radial gradient spots. Place a translucent inset glass card above the gradients with the white title Mesh Gradient Background and a small explanatory subtitle. Move the colored spots slowly so the lighting changes behind the steady text.
prompts.mk-background: Fill the frame with large soft pink and turquoise gradient blobs on white. Drift them gently in opposing directions, pull the full background into a centered rounded card with a soft shadow, then expand it to fill the frame again. Keep this ten-second ambient composition text-free.
prompts.mk-callout-highlight: Set a restrained two-line callout on transparency reading Functionality was our goal from the very beginning. Fade and lift the text into view, then sweep emphasis across the individual words so muted gray becomes dark readable text. Hold the completed phrase and move it upward while fading out at the end of eight seconds.
prompts.ai-chat-reveal: Create a portrait phone-style AI chat on a white canvas. Start with a keyboard rising under the composer and a short question typed character by character. Send it as a rounded bubble, lower the keyboard, and stream the assistant reply into paragraphs and a short list. Finish on a dark green branded card with a play symbol, a large two-line headline, supporting line and pill CTA. Keep the keyboard geometry, readable margins and restrained mobile typography of the reference.
prompts.animated-bar-chart: Build a white rounded analytics card on a pale gray stage. Pair a bold upper-left title with a large +42% figure at upper right. Grow seven charcoal monthly bars in sequence, then draw a soft gray trend line underneath. Hold the completed chart so the result can be read. Use subtle shadows and small muted month labels.
prompts.ascii-render-pass: Fill a pale canvas with a blue monospace ASCII field. Increase the glyph density while a central rectangular negative-space window resolves the word SHIP. Keep the effect as a continuous transformation of the character grid, with no photographic background or additional captions.
prompts.ascii-trail-reveal: Place a violet ASCII grid inside an inset dark rounded panel. Move a small luminous point along a curved path and erase the glyphs behind its sweep until the panel is clear. Retain the fine border and quiet dark framing; the reveal path should provide the visual progression.
prompts.aurora-drift: Create a dark rounded atmospheric panel with large soft violet light fields drifting across it. Keep the gradients heavily blurred, low contrast and slow. Maintain an uninterrupted ambient loop without text, hard edges or sudden changes.
prompts.avatar-cloud: On a navy stage, assemble a ring of small gray circular initial avatars around a central community metric card reading 50k builders. Reveal the avatars in sequence and connect them with delicate radial lines. Hold the completed network, with subtle orbital motion and a clear central focal point.
prompts.avatar-group-hover: Show four overlapping blue circular avatars labelled A, B, C and D on a pale gray background. Use white outlines and a soft group shadow. Animate a gentle hover lift through the group, then settle the circles back into their compact overlapping row.
prompts.badge-pop: Center a small white rounded notification tile with a black outlined bell on a light gray stage. Pop a red circular badge marked 3 onto its top-right corner with a brief overshoot, then hold the settled result. Keep ample negative space around the icon.
prompts.bar-chart-race: Animate a six-row horizontal bar-chart race on a warm off-white canvas. Show the period prominently at upper right and animate changing subscriber values, bar lengths and ranking positions together. Color the leading bar orange-red and the other bars near black. Keep labels and value suffixes readable, and identify the demonstration values as placeholder data.
prompts.beat-accent: Use a dark navy card and a single centered white word, DROP. Give the word a compact rhythmic accent through scale and light, returning to a clean readable resting state after each beat. Keep the background quiet and avoid adding unrelated text or imagery.
prompts.beat-timeline: Build a dark process panel with five stacked rows: Capture, Draft, Review, Ship and Iterate. Reveal the numbered blue circles and their rows in order. Include small muted timing labels beneath each name and finish with the complete sequence visible.
prompts.before-after-wipe: Create a before/after interface comparison on a fine pale grid. Slide a vertical divider with a circular handle across the frame, revealing a blue-lilac styled card against the neutral white version. Keep BEFORE and AFTER labels at the top and preserve alignment of corresponding UI elements through the wipe.
prompts.blur-in: Set the small white line Design systems for video in the center of a black canvas. Bring it from defocused softness into crisp readable type, then hold. Use a restrained transition and generous empty space, matching the minimal reference.
prompts.blur-out-up: Center a large heavy black headline, BLUR OUT UP, on an off-white canvas. Hold the sharp text before its exit, then move it upward while increasing blur and reducing opacity. Preserve the simple monochrome layout and a readable pause before the motion.
prompts.bottom-up-letters: Reveal the cream headline Build with motion against a near-black warm background. Bring individual characters upward from below with staggered timing and a compact settling motion. Finish with the complete bold line centered and motionless long enough to read.
prompts.browser-device-stage: Stage a white desktop browser window on a pale blue-gray background. Include a muted address bar, sidebar and gray skeleton content tiles with lavender accents. Transition between interface layouts within the same browser frame, using a brief light wash and subtle depth rather than a scene cut.
prompts.camera-dolly-zoom: Demonstrate a dolly zoom with a simple orange human figure centered against a pale blue rectangle on navy. Keep the subject nearly constant in size while nested perspective frames change scale around it. Add a small lower-left technical caption and keep the geometric depth cues clear throughout.
prompts.camera-rig-depth-stack: Place a white title card in front of a larger indigo backplate on a pale stage. Animate a restrained 3D camera move so the layers separate with parallax and perspective. Let the front card settle toward a readable face-on view, retaining soft shadows and a short subtitle.
prompts.camera-scan-gate: Begin with a large cyan viewfinder on a dark rounded panel. Contract it inward through faint nested frames, then reveal a cyan checkmark and a small Payment approved label. Hold the confirmed state; use the scan-to-confirm transition as the entire visual story.
prompts.camera-shake: Build a navy geometric city and floor grid with large white CAMERA SHAKE text in the foreground. Apply a controlled handheld camera shake to the scene while keeping the text legible. Include corner framing marks and the small technical readout of the reference; avoid random motion that changes when seeking.
prompts.caption-blend-difference: Move broad cream, navy and red panels behind the oversized two-line caption READS ON ANY COLOR. Reveal the words and use difference blending so their colors respond to the panels beneath. Keep the typography bold and the panel motion smooth, making the contrast change itself the demonstration.
prompts.card-resize: Show a compact white status card on a light gray stage, with a rounded gray icon and Ready to render text. Expand the card smoothly to reveal a smaller explanatory line while preserving the icon and title alignment. Settle into the larger layout with soft corners and a low shadow.
prompts.char-slam-explode: Scatter the violet letters of Detonate across a charcoal card, then pull them into a centered bold word with a forceful overshoot and short impact shake. Finish on clean stable typography. Keep the letter motion deterministic and the surrounding composition minimal.
prompts.chart-story: Tell a growth sequence with five vertical bars labelled Q1 through Q5 on a pale canvas. Raise them one by one and count their values toward 12%, 28%, 45%, 61% and 88%. Keep the first four bars gray and the final bar blue with a matching value badge. Hold the completed comparison.
prompts.chat-message: Recreate the dark phone message demonstration with a single incoming text bubble, then a large emoji response, then a rich green link-preview card. Show one message variant at a time inside the same black phone. Retain the green monospace explanatory column beside the device as part of this component demo.
prompts.chat-thread: Animate a complete iMessage-style conversation inside a black phone on a dark green stage. Accumulate small incoming and blue outgoing bubbles, a green rich-link preview and a final emoji reaction, letting the thread scroll to make space. Keep the green explanatory demo column beside the phone and preserve readable message timing.
prompts.chromatic-aberration-wipe: On a pale stage, wipe a blue-to-violet rounded card across a dark card. Introduce a brief RGB separation at the fast moving edge, then resolve the centered white title into sharp type. Finish with the gradient card fully covering the original, with a soft shadow below.
prompts.code-diff: Show a dark code-editor window with traffic-light controls over a subtle navy-to-green background. Highlight a removed function in muted red, collapse the removed lines, then reveal the replacement in green with plus markers. Keep monospace syntax coloring and hold the final diff for reading.
prompts.code-highlight: Build a dark numbered code window displaying a short configuration-loading function. Move a subdued blue full-width highlight onto the relevant line while dimming surrounding code. Keep the editor chrome and code fixed so the emphasis change is easy to follow.
prompts.code-morph: In a dark code-editor window, transform an imperative JavaScript loop into an equivalent filter/map expression. Move matching syntax tokens between their positions rather than cutting between screenshots. Preserve syntax colors, muted window chrome and a stable frame, then hold the concise result.
prompts.code-scroll: Display a longer retry-fetch function in a dark editor with line numbers. Scroll smoothly down to the request statement and settle a blue highlight band behind that line. Keep the window frame fixed, clip code inside the viewport and allow a reading pause at the target.
prompts.code-terminal-run: Create a black terminal-style window with small traffic-light controls. Type a build command and its indented options, then reveal muted progress output followed by a green success line. Preserve the spacing and command rhythm of the reference instead of inventing extra output.
prompts.code-typing: Type a short syntax-colored configuration-loading function into a dark code-editor window, character by character. Keep line numbers, a visible caret and minimal traffic-light chrome. Use a soft blue-green surrounding glow and finish on the complete function without moving the editor.
prompts.colorama-wipe: Reveal the bold centered COLORAMA WIPE headline against black. Sweep a blue-violet chromatic highlight across the letter shapes as the text appears, then resolve to crisp white type before another restrained color pass. Keep the effect confined to the letters.
prompts.comparison-split: Create a dark comparison panel labelled AUTOMATED on the left and MANUAL on the right. Move a thin white divider and circular handle across a shared mock interface, revealing a smooth solid treatment against a technical grid. Preserve identical geometry on both sides so the styling difference remains obvious.
prompts.confetti: Place a translucent title panel over soft blue, green and pink light fields inside a rounded card. After the title appears, release small multicolored confetti rectangles with gravity and varied rotation. Keep the seeded particle motion repeatable and the central text readable through the celebration.
prompts.conic-progress-ring: Animate a mint circular progress ring around a large white counter on a dark blue-black square card. Synchronize the arc and number as they approach 92, then hold the completed reading. Use a dim remainder track, generous spacing and no extra decoration.
prompts.constellation-hub: Place a violet-outlined Creator OS node at the center of a dark panel. Reveal five surrounding nodes labelled Capture, Compose, Animate, Render and Publish, then draw thin violet links from the center. Keep the hub visually dominant and hold the completed constellation.
prompts.cosmic-orb: Render a luminous spherical orb against near black. Give it a thin blue-violet rim, cloudy purple interior, tiny star-like points and slow swirling motion. Keep the sphere centered and preserve its round silhouette throughout the atmospheric loop.
prompts.count-up: Show a large lavender currency amount on a dark rounded panel. Count smoothly from a low value to $12,500+, with stable separators and aligned digits, then hold the final amount. Keep the dollar sign and plus smaller than the numerals and avoid layout jitter.
prompts.cta-close: Build a closing card on a warm off-white canvas. Reveal the large black serif headline Ship your first film, then bring in a purple pill button reading Get started free underneath. Keep the final two-element lockup centered with ample breathing room.
prompts.cta-lockup: On a charcoal rounded card, reveal the bold white headline Build your next video. Bring a small lavender Try it now pill beneath it, followed by the muted line No credit card required. Use a restrained stagger, then hold the complete CTA lockup.
prompts.cursor-glyph-trail: Demonstrate a white notifications settings window on a pale background. Move a black cursor through a toggle, frequency option and save button, leaving a dotted blue trail and numbered blue click markers. Show each setting change at the pointer arrival and keep the window stationary.
prompts.cut-the-curve: Animate a small dark message card through a quick curved handoff across a navy panel. Let the card blur briefly during its fastest movement and resolve sharply into its final position. Keep its three simple text strokes and the low background glow intact.
prompts.decline-chart: Draw a descending pink retention line inside a dark analytics card as the upper-right metric counts down toward 26. Darken the blue ambient background as the line falls. Keep the WEEKLY RETENTION label, faint horizontal guides and a clear final hold.
prompts.directional-wipe: Slide a gray scene panel across a dark rounded card on a pale background. Let the moving edge reveal the bold white Directional Wipe headline and fine vertical texture. Resolve the edge cleanly and hold the new panel without extra elements.
prompts.drift-hold: Center a compact blue-gray card labelled Quiet momentum on a nearly black navy stage. Apply barely perceptible rotation and scale breathing plus a slow light sweep. Keep the title readable and the motion suitable for an uninterrupted ambient hold.
prompts.dynamic-grid: Create a very dark teal background with a subtle responsive grid treatment. Place a bold two-line white Dynamic grid motion heading at lower left with a smaller muted explanatory line. Keep the grid motion subdued so this remains a usable background for interface and data scenes.
prompts.echo-trail: Move a small white message card across a pale gray canvas along a smooth arcing path. Follow it with several translucent copies at earlier positions, fading each successive echo. Collapse the trail into the settled card at the end; use the same time offsets on every seek.
prompts.extended-keyframe: On black, animate the white word EXTENDED into a clear left-of-center resting position. Use a longer positional and blur transition to hand off to KEYFRAME near the center, then let the text leave to an empty ending. Preserve the sparse typography and the visibly extended transition curve.
prompts.facet-morph: Place a low-poly faceted object on a pale gray canvas. Continuously morph its silhouette from a rounded form through an angular star-like shape into a tall narrow form, using lavender highlights and charcoal faces. Keep the triangulated surface coherent while the shape changes.
prompts.fade-through: Show a white light-mode settings card on a light stage, then fade it through an intermediate state into a charcoal dark-mode card. Change the headline and appearance pill with the mode while retaining the same layout. Hold the dark result with readable white text and a soft shadow.
prompts.focus-blur-resolve: Center the heavy black words Crystal clear on an off-white canvas. Begin defocused, reduce the blur smoothly until the text is crisp, and hold the resolved title. Keep position and scale stable so the focus change carries the effect.
prompts.focus-swap: Stage two dark project cards side by side. Start with the left Shape the idea card sharp and the right Ship the result card blurred; shift focus to the right while softening the left. Preserve both cards in place and use focus and contrast to transfer attention.
prompts.gesture-tap: Display a white profile card inside a dark panel with a Connect pill button. Animate a translucent tap indicator pressing the button, then change it to a lavender Connected state. Hold the completed interaction with the profile layout unchanged.
prompts.grain-overlay: Create a warm cream-to-gold background with fine analog grain. Reveal the centered dark Grain Overlay heading and its smaller supporting line, then hold while the texture remains subtle. Keep the text crisp and the grain fine enough to avoid overpowering the composition.
prompts.grid-card-assemble: Assemble a two-by-three grid of white feature cards on a pale background. Reveal lavender line icons and small uppercase labels for permissions, audit trail, deployment, search, drafts and citations in a staggered sequence. Keep card spacing consistent and finish with the whole grid visible.
prompts.grid-pixelate-wipe: Transition between a purple Scene A and a pink Scene B using an irregular grid of black square tiles. Vary tile sizes and stagger their appearance to cover and reveal the scenes, then reverse back to the first scene. Keep the centered white captions and gradient backgrounds of the demo.
prompts.halftone-dissolve: Change a white Before card into a pale lavender After card using a wave of blue halftone circles. Let the dots expand and pass across the composition before clearing to the new card. Preserve the centered card geometry, subtle shadow and blue result text.
prompts.halftone-field: Fill a black canvas with a tightly spaced field of small circular dots. Modulate their sizes and colors into moving violet, lime and cyan waves while leaving dark gaps between them. Keep the pattern continuous and repeatable without captions or additional objects.
prompts.hw-scribble-transition: Sweep thick golden-orange marker strokes diagonally across a transparent canvas until they fully cover it, then sweep them away to reveal transparency again. Use rounded stroke ends and an energetic handwritten rhythm. Keep this as a reusable wipe layer with no text.
prompts.icon-morph-beat: Center a small rounded dark icon tile on a charcoal panel. Morph a white closed lock into a lavender unlocked lock on a single deliberate beat. Add a restrained settling accent and hold the open-lock state, keeping the tile stationary.
prompts.ink-bleed-reveal: Use dark blue organic ink blobs on a warm paper-gray background. Let the blobs gather, spread and recede to reveal the large blue word INK with a tiny letter-spaced BLEED REVEAL subtitle. Keep the shapes fluid and the final typography clean and centered.
prompts.iris-reveal: Begin with a muted gray interface card on a dark grid. Expand a circular iris to reveal a richer teal-and-navy version with blue and green interface accents. Finish with the entire colored scene visible while corresponding card elements remain aligned.
prompts.keyframe-scrub-stack: Stack three pale translucent keyframe cards inside a white rounded stage. Shift the cards through their recorded positions, bringing the first card forward and settling the stack. Include small keyframe labels and compact bar indicators so the motion reads as a timeline-scrubbing demonstration.
prompts.chromatic-radial-split: Recreate the two-column shader demonstration: a large animated panel at left and a compact violet title, prompt strip and explanation at right. Transition the left panel from dark indigo to bright periwinkle with a radial RGB split during the handoff. Resolve to a clean solid endpoint and keep the explanatory column fixed.
prompts.cinematic-zoom: Build the split shader-demo layout with a large purple preview area and a narrow explanatory column. Transition the preview toward saturated golden yellow with a dramatic zoom-blur handoff and brief chromatic separation. Keep the title and prompt strip yellow and preserve sharp endpoints around the transition.
prompts.cross-warp-morph: Use a dark olive split demo layout with a lime title and fixed explanatory column. Morph the large left panel into lime through a turbulent organic boundary, warping both sides in opposite directions. Let the noise-driven shapes clear completely into a flat final color.
prompts.domain-warp-dissolve: Create a navy shader-demo composition with a large preview panel and a fixed cyan explanatory column. Dissolve the preview into bright turquoise using flowing fractal contours with pink and electric-blue rims. Keep the strongest detail near the moving boundary and resolve to a clean final fill.
prompts.flash-through-white: Recreate a dark navy split transition demo with a golden title and explanatory strip at right. Flash the large left preview to white during the handoff, then resolve it into saturated yellow. Keep the surrounding column dark and stable so the flash is confined to the demonstration region.
prompts.glitch: Build a charcoal split shader demo with an orange title and prompt strip at right. Change the left preview from slate to coral using short horizontal block displacement, scan-line interference and chromatic glitch artifacts. Keep the start and end clean and the disruption concentrated around the cut.
prompts.grain-field: Fill a dark gray canvas with a clearly visible regular field of small lavender dots. Drift the field slowly over a subtle luminance gradient while keeping its spacing and scale stable. Make the ambient motion loop exactly and omit text or foreground objects.
prompts.gravitational-lens: Create a near-black violet split shader demonstration with a magenta title and fixed explanation at right. Transition the large left panel toward vivid magenta using a central gravity-well distortion and expanding lensing boundary. Preserve clean color endpoints and keep the sidebar outside the distortion.
prompts.kinetic-type-swap: Center the white sentence Make motion visible inside a black rounded card. Roll the lavender middle word through a masked slot until it settles on momentum, keeping Make and visible fixed. Size the slot for the widest option so the surrounding sentence does not jump.
prompts.light-leak: Use a dark teal split demo with an orange title and fixed prompt strip at right. Wash the large preview with a warm amber light leak, moving from a dark starting scene through a bright soft flare into saturated orange. Keep the glow directional and the endpoints clean.
prompts.light-sweep-pass: Arrange a wide white interface card above three smaller cards on a light gray stage. Sweep a broad soft key light across them, shifting each card's highlights and shadows together while their positions remain fixed. Settle into even lighting and preserve the small violet accents.
prompts.line-by-line-slide: Reveal three large black lines on white: Design faster, Render cleaner, Ship louder. Slide the lines in from the left with a short stagger and slight transitional blur, then hold the full left-aligned stack. Send them out to the right at the close.
prompts.line-swap: Center Everyone ships demos. in white on black. After a reading pause, replace the whole line through an upward mask with Almost nobody ships proof. entering from below. Draw a short violet underline beneath proof and hold the second statement.
prompts.locked-nucleus-orbit: Place a small glowing violet nucleus labelled ANCHOR at the center of a dark panel. Animate labelled satellite pills along several fine concentric orbits, then settle them into a balanced lockup. Keep the nucleus absolutely fixed so the surrounding orbital movement remains clear.
prompts.logo-wall: Build a dark trusted-by panel with a small uppercase TRUSTED BY TEAMS label. Reveal a six-by-four grid of placeholder lettermark tiles using a compact stagger and gentle scale-in. Hold the full wall with consistent gutters and gray badges; the initials are placeholders, not claims of real customer endorsements.
